eligibility_criteria: 1. MSc- Health Data Science is open to graduates from all streams with a minimum of 50% marks. However, the candidate must have earned a certificate in computer programming such as C programming, Python, SQL, etc. from a recognized institution or from Swayam NPTL. 2. Candidates with undergraduation in Engineering, Computer Sciences, Biotechnology, Health Informatics, Pharmacy etc. are encouraged to apply.
